items.title: Magnitude-5.5 earthquake 'morning wake-up call' to remote community
items.description: A remote community in the APY Lands have woken up to rattling shelves and swinging lights caused by a magnitude-5.5 earthquake, Geoscience Australia says.

items.title: Iran rejects Trump's 48-hour ultimatum as Gulf strikes widen

featured_image.name: Kuwait desalination plant, oil refinery hit by missile and drone strikes

items.description:
Iran's central military command on Saturday dismissed President Donald Trump's 48-hour ultimatum to reopen the Strait of Hormuz or face the destruction of its critical infrastructure, as Tehran continued launching waves of drone and missile strikes across the Gulf and at Israel in the latest escalation of the five-week-old war.

General Ali Abdollahi Aliabadi, representing Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, called Trump's threat "a helpless, nervous, unbalanced and stupid action," and warned: "The simple meaning of this message is that the gates of hell will open for you." Trump had written on Truth Social earlier Saturday: "Time is running out — 48 hours before all Hell will reign down on them. Glory be to GOD!"[1][2][3]

items.title: Man in serious condition after being shot by Tasmania Police
items.description: A man is in a serious but stable condition after being shot by police during an altercation in Hobart's northern suburbs early on Sunday morning.

items.title: Meloni offers to help rebuild Qatar's war-damaged gas infrastructure

featured_image.name: Italy's Meloni meets Qatar emir to discuss energy issues amid Iran war

items.description:
Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni met with Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani at Lusail Palace in Doha on Saturday, offering Italy's support to rebuild Qatar's damaged energy infrastructure as Europe grapples with an energy crisis triggered by the US-Israeli war on Iran.[1][2]

Meloni is the first leader from the European Union, NATO, and the G20 to visit the Gulf region since the conflict began on February 28. The unannounced two-day tour, which started in Saudi Arabia on Friday with a meeting with Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, will also include the United Arab Emirates.[3][4][5]

items.title: Sisters of officer killed by Dezi Freeman to sue Victoria Police
items.description: Leading Senior Constable Neal Thompson's sisters plan to launch legal action against Victoria Police over his death. They also say they felt "abandoned" by police after their brother's death.

items.title: Iran's military warns Israeli embassies are 'legitimate targets'

featured_image.name: Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya Headquarters details Waves 91 & 92 of “Al-Waad  Al-Sadiq 4”

items.description: Iran's top military command issued a stark warning on Saturday that any Israeli attack on Iranian embassies or diplomatic facilities would prompt retaliatory strikes on Israeli diplomatic sites across the Middle East, escalating rhetoric amid an ongoing military conflict between Iran and a US-Israeli coalition.

items.title: Iran's grip on Strait of Hormuz fuels growing recession fears worldwide

featured_image.name: The Oil Shock Is Here. And We're Just Beginning to Feel It.

items.description: A grinding war in Iran and the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz have sent oil prices surging and rattled financial markets worldwide, intensifying fears that the global economy may be headed for a recession. With crude benchmarks trading well above $100 a barrel and bond yields falling, Wall Street is signaling that the risk of economic contraction now outweighs concerns about inflation.

items.title: Trump warns Iran of 'hell' as search for downed jet crew enters day 2

featured_image.name: Trump says Iran has 48 hours to make deal as search for US pilot continues

items.description: President Donald Trump dismissed the loss of an American F-15E Strike Eagle fighter jet over Iran on Friday, telling NBC News in a phone interview that the incident would have no bearing on ongoing diplomatic efforts with Tehran. "No, not at all. No, it's war. We're in war, Garrett," Trump told NBC News correspondent Garrett Haake, in his first public remarks on the shootdown.[1][2][3]

items.title: Trump aides advise striking Iran's infrastructure as Monday deadline nears

featured_image.name: Trump extends pause on attacking Iran energy facilities to April 6

items.description:
Senior Trump administration officials have privately advised President Donald Trump that striking Iran's energy and power infrastructure constitutes a legitimate military target, according to The Wall Street Journal, as the U.S.-Iran war enters its sixth week with a critical deadline just two days away.[1][2]

The reporting comes as Trump's self-imposed April 6 deadline for Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz or reach a deal approaches on Monday evening. On Saturday, Trump reiterated his ultimatum on Truth Social, warning that "all hell" would rain down on Iran if it fails to comply within 48 hours.[3][4]

items.title: Israel warns it will strike Lebanon-Syria border crossing

featured_image.name: Key Lebanon–Syria border crossing destroyed by Israeli attack

items.description: The Israel Defense Forces carried out simultaneous waves of strikes across Iran and Lebanon over the weekend, hitting more than 200 Iranian targets and over 140 Hezbollah positions as the five-week-old Operation Roaring Lion continued to expand in scope. The IDF also confirmed the death of another soldier in southern Lebanon, bringing the toll to 11 since ground operations began on March 16.[1][2][3]

items.title: Houthis claim joint strike with Iran on Ben Gurion Airport

featured_image.name: Houthi missile strike at Israel airport halts flights - NPR

items.description:
Yemen's Houthi movement claimed Saturday that it struck Ben Gurion Airport near Tel Aviv and military targets in southern Israel using a fragmentation ballistic missile and attack drones, in what the group described as a joint operation with Iran's Revolutionary Guard, the Iranian army, and Hezbollah in Lebanon.[1][2]

Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said in a prerecorded statement that the group had "successfully struck Lod Airport (Ben Gurion) in the occupied Jaffa area" along with what he called vital military targets in southern occupied Palestine. "This operation was a joint operation with the Revolutionary Guard, the Iranian army, and Hezbollah in Lebanon, and it successfully achieved its objectives," Saree said.[1]

items.title: Iran launches 95th wave of strikes on U.S. bases across Gulf

featured_image.name: Patriot missile involved in Bahrain blast likely US-operated, analysis finds

items.description: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps carried out a sweeping series of strikes on Saturday targeting U.S. military positions in Kuwait, Bahrain, and the United Arab Emirates, marking the 95th wave of Operation True Promise 4 since the war began five weeks ago. The Iranian Navy also claimed to have set ablaze an Israeli-linked commercial vessel near the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Drone strikes wound 3 at BP-run oilfield in Iraq

featured_image.name: Operations halted at Iraq gas field after shock drone strike

items.description: Two drones struck the BP-operated North Rumaila oilfield in southern Iraq on Saturday, wounding three Iraqi workers, as a separate drone targeted offices belonging to American energy services company KBR at the nearby Majnoon oil field, underscoring the continued vulnerability of Iraq's energy infrastructure more than a month into the broader conflict between the United States, Israel, and Iran.

items.description: The US president says the airman whose F-15 jet was downed in Iran has suffered injuries but will be "fine" after dozens of "daring" US military "armed with the most lethal weapons in the world" retrieved him. Follow live.
